{{Top|leg}}
'''Varvvans''' were large sentient creatures from the [[Varvva system/Legends|Varvva system]]. The species had a reputation for bravery and fearlessness. Their eyeballs could be extended out of their sockets, and in states of extreme agitation or anger, the eyeballs oozed.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
